title: May you all be Defenders of Truth
body:
We are grateful to Allah that the King of England in the year 2000, Crown prince Charles, will be a Sultan of
Islam. He is praising Islam everywhere, much more than our people do. He is on the right path, even though
devils are trying to stop him. He knows that people will only get their rights back if they are ruled by Divine
Laws. He is brave, because he is from the line of the Prophet s.a.s. . He is a Defender of Truth. May you all be
Defenders of Truth.
01.01.1997
